lines.text: The writer urges them to test their ways, turn back to the LORD, and confess they have sinned and rebelled.
God covered Himself with a cloud no prayer can pass through and made them scum among the nations.
Without cause his enemies hunted him like a bird and dropped him alive into a fiery furnace.
From the Pit the writer called on the LORD's name, and the LORD drew near and said, "Be still."
The writer says the LORD will pay them back for the work of their hands and pursue them in anger.
